operator_extractions.computes: rolling 95th percentile of simple H1 returns divided by the absolute rolling 5th percentile plus 1e-12, over 168 observations with at least 120

operator_extractions.name: ou_rev_press
operator_extractions.computes: over a right-aligned 168-bar window, demean log(close) by its rolling mean; regress its change on its lag to obtain b; theta=-log(1+b) for -1<b<0, theta=0 for b>=0 and NaN for b<=-1; output -tanh(deviation_z)*sqrt(clip(theta/rolling_median(theta),0,5))
operator_extractions.mt5_analogue: H1 price-only mean-reversion pressure per terminal-enumerated Fusion symbol, optionally cross-sectionally ranked at a point-in-time common decision timestamp
operator_extractions.data_gap: none for the transform; the source admits small-sample theta bias, so theta is relative state rather than an absolute half-life estimate
operator_extractions.evidence_disposition: operator specification only; source comments claiming positive h1/h4/h24 t-statistics are not reproduced evidence
